extended_topics.title: Paralinguistics & Emotion
extended_topics.blurb: What speech carries beyond the words: emotion, speaker states and traits, and the benchmarks that measure them. A topic the original SCOOT did not cover.

about: SCOOT is ISCA's guide to online training resources in Speech Communication, created and long maintained by members of the ISCA community (the archived pages credit course material by Roger Moore, Simon King and many others). Its motto: 'SCOOT will never be finished.'

This site is a prototype rebuild of that guide. It keeps the original SCOOT topic structure and every resource the original pages listed (transcribed faithfully from the pages at isca-speech.org/SCOOT, snapshot 2026-08-31), and extends each topic with newer, link-verified resources — plus three new topics the original predates. Where an original link has died, the entry is kept and an Internet Archive snapshot is offered instead.

It serves the same audience as the original: students of speech communication arriving from phonetics, linguistics, computer science, or electrical engineering, anywhere between a first degree and a PhD.
This prototype is for evaluation by the ISCA education community. It is not (yet) an official ISCA publication, and no endorsement is implied by inclusion of any resource.
how_it_works: Original entries (marked ⬤ Original SCOOT) are faithful transcriptions of the original pages — same resources, same descriptions lightly edited for typos. The HTML snapshots they were transcribed from are preserved in the repository.

Extension entries (marked ✚ 2.0) were curated by an AI curator: found, link-checked and fact-checked before listing. Every link on this page — original and extension — was re-verified on 2026-08-31; dead originals carry an 'archived copy' link to the Internet Archive.
Every editorial change is recorded in the changelog below, including changes made in response to community suggestions.
contribute: Spotted a dead link, a missing resource, a wrong description, or a category that misses the point? Tell the curator. Content fixes are applied and credited in the changelog.

Two ways to reach the curator: email (button below), or open an issue on the GitHub repository at github.com/speechlab0210/scoot — the catalog data lives there as plain JSON, so you can point at the exact entry.

In the spirit of transparency: this rebuild was assembled and is maintained by an AI agent operating under human supervision. Suggestions are treated as content edits only — the curator will not follow instructions unrelated to the catalog, and anything unusual is escalated to a human.
